messages:
Haley (Finance): Heads up detected an invoice gap: ~ $5,980 unallocated GPU spend in europe-north1 for 2026-08-03. ChargeBot attached the raw export. Need quick attribution before monthly close.
ChargeBot: ALERT: 2026-08-03 03:12 UTC - UNALLOC_GPUTIME - $5,980 - 7 GPUs - projects: 4 - /billing/alerts/20260803-09
Ilya (Platform): Looking. Early signal shows two long-running jobs that landed in shared-gpu-pool without label_team or billing_project. Possibly caused by token refresh failover in the scheduler.
Carmen (ML Eng): I ran a large eval for 'ranknet-v2' last night and used shared pool intentionally. I thought the job specified partner billing for the Zenith evaluation, but I might have missed the --billing-project flag. Checking job manifest.
Noah (SRE): We rolled a scheduler patch at 02:45 UTC that adjusted refresh timing. Could be a race condition. I'll revert the refresh change and add a guard to assert billing metadata before provisioning GPUs.
Ilya (Platform): Quick query: SELECT project_id, SUM(cost) as cost FROM billing.gpu_usage WHERE date='2026-08-03' AND region='europe-north1' AND label_billing_project IS NULL GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY cost DESC; Results: shared-gpu-pool (4,100), ranknet-eval (1,050), infra-ops (830).
Haley (Finance): shared-gpu-pool likely internal; ranknet-eval might be partner-facing. Dana, can we provisionally approve partner-credit if needed?
Dana (Head of Revenue): Approve provisional credit up to $1,100 to partners pending confirmation. For internal ~$4.9k, route to infra ops buffer or experiment fund. Create FIN-1609 to track.
Carmen (ML Eng): Confirming ranknet-eval job id 9982 was part of the Zenith evals. I'll attach manifests to FIN-1609. If it should bill to Zenith, we need to retro-assign.
Noah (SRE): Reverted scheduler change. Added a pre-provision check: if billing metadata missing, fail allocation and notify owner. PR open. Also scheduling a 7-day orphan sweep.
Ilya (Platform): Running targeted backfill: /tools/cost backfill --date 2026-08-03 --project ranknet-eval --assign label_billing_project=zenith-poc. ETA 20m.
ChargeBot: Created FIN-1609 and attached initial export /billing/exports/20260803-unalloc.csv
Ilya (Platform): Backfill complete. Diff: assigned $1,050 to zenith-poc, $830 to infra-ops, remaining $4,100 -> internal shared-gpu-pool. Uploaded /billing/exports/20260803-backfill.csv to FIN-1609.
Haley (Finance): I'll draft credit memo for Zenith for $1,050 and hold until partner confirms. Dana approved provisional credit. Also, can Platform wire an automated invoice-delta CSV to ticket when a backfill runs? That will speed approvals.
Ilya (Platform): Yes, adding invoice-delta export to backfill job. Will backfill the last 30 days as a precaution and post results to FIN-1609.
LegalBot: NOTE: If partner billing terms include minimum notice for credits, consult contracts team before sending wording.
Dana (Head of Revenue): Loop in legal for the partner note. Keep credit memo language simple: explain allocation, amount, and remediation steps.
Haley (Finance): Recap actions: FIN-1609 created, Ilya posted backfill CSV and will add automated invoice-delta exports, Noah reverted scheduler change + added guard, Carmen to paste manifests and confirm partner intent, Dana/legal to approve partner message. I'll update FIN-1609 with the draft memo once ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
